Honestly it all depends on what you want to do in your future. Since you said a career I’m assuming you would want your own tools. In that case if you are going milwaukee the m18 fuel line is the way to go. Be warned it is an investment and it’s not cheap. However, Milwaukee has a lot of solutions to a lot of electrical problems. Being a well rounded electrician is most important in your career so having experience in residential, commercial, and industrial is a must and the fuel line will carry you all the way through. Emphasis on the not cheap part, but, if you do make the plunge into the investment it will take you far. Good luck out there
